takeoverPullRequestBody:
Take over experimental {package} at its existing tag `{version}` from source commit `{source}`. No tag or GitHub Release is created; `{version}` stays where it is.

Checked before this PR was opened:
- `Sources/` is byte-identical to tag `{version}`; only a missing `Version.swift` may be added.
- `Package.swift` is semantically equal (`swift package dump-package`: products, targets, platforms, dependency requirements).

Expected differences (anything else is a stop):
- `Package.swift` text differs (formatting, order, comments): it is generated from the inventory.
- No `testTarget`: tests stay in the monorepo.
- `LICENSE.md` is replaced by the generated `LICENSE` (or the other way round).
- `Tests/`, `Example/`, xcodeproj, `Package.resolved`, `CODEOWNERS` and the rest of `.github/` are removed; the generated `.github/CODEOWNERS`, CONTRIBUTING and README block are added.
- Integrations depend on `experimental-rudder-sdk-swift` instead of `rudder-sdk-swift` (same requirement; experiment only).

{removed}{ticket}
